final_sql:
SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT schools.MailStreet
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T2.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1."FRPM Count (K-12)" = (
    SELECT MAX("FRPM Count (K-12)")
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded'

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) > 0.3
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / satscores.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT schools.School,
       schools.NCESSchool,
       frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.dname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T1.dname
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools AS s 
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds 
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' 
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' 
  AND t.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' 
  AND "Low Grade" = '9' 
  AND "High Grade" = '12';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
  AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T3.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T3.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sc.Phone
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR strftime('%Y', sc.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
    SELECT AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm AS T1
    INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
    WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS TotalEnrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY TotalEnrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)"
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Website
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s."AdmEmail1"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Admin1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Admin2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Admin3
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.cname = 'Los Angeles'
  AND st.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' 
  AND T1.cname = 'Fresno'

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sa.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SchoolName
FROM (
    SELECT sc.School AS SchoolName,
           sc.Virtual AS Virtual,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sa
    JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND rnk <= 5;

SELECT schools.EILName
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.City
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 = (
    SELECT MAX(NumGE1500)
    FROM satscores
);

SELECT T2.sname, T2.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = 31
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
      SELECT County
      FROM schools
      WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
      GROUP BY County
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT s.sname AS School_Name, sc.MailStreet AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s.MailStreet, t.sname
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores T1 
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500 
  AND T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT SUM(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Fresno'

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian');

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
  SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt');

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailState = 'CA' 
  AND StatusType = 'Active' 
  AND City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT sch.Phone, sch.Ext
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sch ON st.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE st.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY st.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE City = 'Hickman' AND Charter = 1 AND DOC = 52

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = '0'
  AND T1.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] * 100.0 / T1.[Enrollment (K-12)] < 0.18;

SELECT School,
       City,
       AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Administrator1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Administrator2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Administrator3
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = '1'
  AND CharterNum = '00D2';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode)
FROM schools
WHERE OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '12/31/2005'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_closures
FROM schools
WHERE DOCType = 'Community College District'
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) = '1989'
  AND City = 'San Francisco';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT NCESDist FROM schools WHERE SOC = 31;

SELECT COUNT(StatusType)
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alpine'
  AND StatusType IN ('Active', 'Closed')
  AND (SOCType = 'District Community Day School' OR DOCType = 'District Community Day School');
SELECT District FROM schools WHERE Magnet = 0 AND City = 'Fresno'

SELECT T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.City = 'Fremont'
  AND T1.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND T2.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT T2.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040'
  AND T1.EdOpsName LIKE '%Youth Authority School%';

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
WHERE EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'
  AND NCESDist = '0613360';

SELECT schools.EILName AS `Educational Level Name`, schools.School AS `School Name`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`County Code` = '37';

SELECT schools.City
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND frpm.`County Name` = 'Merced'
  AND schools.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT s.School,
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-9'
  AND s.County = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'F'
  AND County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T1.Latitude, T2.`School Type`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.City, T2.`Low Grade`, T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY T1.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT Fname, District
FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools
)
WHERE Fname IS NOT NULL
  AND Fname IN (
      SELECT Fname
      FROM (
          SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT AdmFName2 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT AdmFName3 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
      )
      GROUP BY Fname
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 2
  );

SELECT f."District Code",
       f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmLName1 AS "Administrator Last Name",
       District,
       County,
       School
FROM schools
WHERE CharterNum = '40';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1, T2.AdmEmail2, T2.AdmEmail3
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND T2.City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND T2.DOC = 54
  AND T2.SOC = 62
  AND T2.OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DisplayName, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01';

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM users 
WHERE Views > 10 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CreationDate) AS INTEGER) > 2013;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts);

SELECT SUM(p.CommentCount) AS TotalComments
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie');

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts p 
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id 
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' 
  AND p.ParentId IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.Age > 65 AND posts.Score >= 20;

SELECT u.Location
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON posts.Id = tags.ExcerptPostId
WHERE tags.Count = (SELECT MAX(Count) FROM tags);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(badges.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(users.DisplayName) AS average_badges
FROM users
LEFT JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE users.Views > 200;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN p.Id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = 58 AND CreationDate = '2010-07-19'

SELECT CreationDate
FROM votes
GROUP BY CreationDate
ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Revival';

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
JOIN comments ON posts.Id = comments.PostId
WHERE comments.Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM comments)

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 3025
  AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39.0';

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT CASE
           WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'not well-finished'
           ELSE 'well-finished'
       END AS status
FROM posts p
WHERE p.Id = (
    SELECT c.PostId
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.UserId = 23853
      AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
);

SELECT u.Reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Id = 65041;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts 
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id 
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.Id = 6347;

SELECT COUNT(v.Id) AS NumberOfVotes
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data visualization%';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'DatEpicCoderGuyWhoPrograms';
SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = '24') AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = '24') AS posts_to_votes_ratio;
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'SilentGhost';

SELECT c.Text

WITH Consumption2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotal
    FROM Consumption2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestConsumers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumption,
           COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers
    FROM Consumption2013 AS t
    JOIN MinConsumption AS m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           TotalConsumption / NumCustomers AS AvgConsumption
    FROM LowestConsumers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'A'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT CAST(t.balance AS REAL) AS b
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT CAST(t.balance AS REAL) AS b
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
)
SELECT (balance_end.b - balance_start.b) * 100.0 / balance_start.b AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;

WITH total_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM total_cons
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, CAST(SUM(t.total_consumption) AS REAL) / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM total_cons AS t
    JOIN min_cons AS m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
minTotals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS minTotal
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgSeg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annualAvg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minTotals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.minTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgSeg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgSeg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgSeg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgSeg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgSeg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgSeg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           substr(y.Date, 1, 4) AS yr,
           SUM(y.Consumption)   AS cons
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, yr
),
pct AS (
    SELECT y12.Segment,
           (y13.cons - y12.cons) * 100.0 / y13.cons AS percentage
    FROM yearly y12
    JOIN yearly y13
         ON y12.Segment = y13.Segment
        AND y13.yr = '2013'
    WHERE y12.yr = '2012'
)
SELECT Segment, percentage
FROM pct
WHERE percentage = (SELECT MAX(percentage) FROM pct)
   OR percentage = (SELECT MIN(percentage) FROM pct);

JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
  AND T2.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(T3.amount)
      FROM loan AS T3
      WHERE T3.duration > 12
  );

JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)

LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.amount
FROM trans T
JOIN account A ON A.account_id = T.account_id
WHERE T.account_id = (
    SELECT L.account_id
    FROM loan L
    ORDER BY L.amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
  AND T.date >= A.date
ORDER BY T.date ASC, T.trans_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district

    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC

SELECT (
    (SELECT t1.balance
     FROM trans t1
     WHERE t1.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY loan_id LIMIT 1)
       AND t1.date = '1998-12-27')
    -
    (SELECT t2.balance
     FROM trans t2
     WHERE t2.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY loan_id LIMIT 1)
       AND t2.date = '1993-03-22')
) * 100.0 /
    (SELECT t3.balance
     FROM trans t3
     WHERE t3.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY loan_id LIMIT 1)
       AND t3.date = '1993-03-22') AS increase_rate;
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan;

FROM account AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a

JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12) AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.date LIKE '93%';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id

WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) -
   SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, SUM(z.annual_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.annual_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

            SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

)
SELECT Segment, Percentage
FROM rates
WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM rates)

JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L."T-BIL" < 2.0;

FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'

FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'

  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.PLT > 400 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

ORDER BY COUNT(e.Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1997' AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'

FROM Examination e

FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GPT > 60

SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT p.Admission, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALP < 300
GROUP BY p.Admission;

JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

SELECT T2.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.Date,
       l.ALB,
       CASE
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.UA > 6.5 THEN T1.ID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT Laboratory.ID, Laboratory.UA
    FROM Laboratory
    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS MaxDate
        FROM Laboratory
        GROUP BY ID
    ) AS Latest
    ON Laboratory.ID = Latest.ID AND Laboratory.Date = Latest.MaxDate
) AS T
JOIN Patient ON Patient.ID = T.ID
WHERE (Patient.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
   OR (Patient.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5);

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

);

FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory);

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

SELECT L.ID, L."T-CHO"

  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS higher_than_normal_count,

WITH cust_consumption AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, cc.total_consumption
    FROM cust_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment m 
        ON cc.Segment = m.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS pct_change
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT Segment, pct_change
FROM (SELECT Segment, pct_change FROM pct ORDER BY pct_change DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL

FROM (SELECT Segment, pct_change FROM pct ORDER BY pct_change ASC LIMIT 1);

WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c 
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE c.gender = 'M' 
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  );

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND d.type = 'Owner'

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.account_id, l.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'C'
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(amount)
      FROM loan
      WHERE status = 'C'
        AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1997'
  );

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1993
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND CAST(SUBSTR(a2.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1993
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)

JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date = (SELECT MIN(date)
              FROM trans
              WHERE date >= '1995-01-01' AND date < '1996-01-01');

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT a.date
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840

SELECT a.district_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH max_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN max_loan ml ON ml.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC, t.trans_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT disp.disp_id
FROM trans
JOIN disp ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 5100
  AND trans.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
  AND account.date LIKE '96%';

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'

LIMIT 1;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT ((t2.balance - t1.balance) * 100.0 / t1.balance) AS increase_rate
FROM trans t1
JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE t1.account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
      AND status IN ('A', 'C')
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
)
  AND t1.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND t2.date = '1998-12-27';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993'

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district r ON a.district_id = r.district_id
WHERE r.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT l.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT d.A2 AS district, ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_percentage
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(*) AS num_female_account_holders

JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

WHERE LOWER(d.A3) = 'south bohemia'

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

WHERE l.account_id IN (

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts

WHERE district_id = (

    ORDER BY CAST(A16 AS INTEGER) DESC

);

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AvgCons ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AvgCons ELSE 0 END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AvgCons ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AvgCons ELSE 0 END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AvgCons ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AvgCons ELSE 0 END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(TotalCons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AvgCons
    FROM (
        SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalCons,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.Segment ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC) AS rnk
        FROM customers c
        JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
    ) t1
    WHERE rnk = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
) t2

    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
);

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_1');
SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2' INTERSECT SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '-') * 1.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 's' AND T4.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.molecule_id) > 5

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=' AND m.label = 'TR024';

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) sub
);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN atom AS atom2 ON connected.atom_id2 = atom2.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'h' AND atom2.element = 'h' AND bond.bond_type = '#';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = 'TR008' AND atom.element = 'c';

SELECT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)

SELECT atom.element, bond.bond_type

SELECT a.atom_id

WITH CommentCounts AS (
    -- Count comments per user
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(Id) AS CommentCount
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
),
TopUsers AS (
    -- Keep only users with the maximum comment count
    SELECT UserId, CommentCount
    FROM CommentCounts
    WHERE CommentCount = (SELECT MAX(CommentCount) FROM CommentCounts)
)

SELECT
  -- SME's annual average minus LAM's annual average
  (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth
   WHERE CustomerID IN (
       SELECT y.CustomerID
       FROM yearmonth y
       JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
       WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
         AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
         AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       GROUP BY y.CustomerID
       ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
       LIMIT 1))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth
   WHERE CustomerID IN (
       SELECT y.CustomerID
       FROM yearmonth y
       JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
       WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
         AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
         AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       GROUP BY y.CustomerID
       ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
       LIMIT 1))
  AS SME_minus_LAM,

  -- LAM's annual average minus KAM's annual average
  (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth
   WHERE CustomerID IN (
       SELECT y.CustomerID
       FROM yearmonth y
       JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
       WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
         AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
         AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       GROUP BY y.CustomerID
       ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
       LIMIT 1))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth
   WHERE CustomerID IN (
       SELECT y.CustomerID
       FROM yearmonth y
       JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
       WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
         AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
         AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       GROUP BY y.CustomerID
       ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
       LIMIT 1))
  AS LAM_minus_KAM,

  -- KAM's annual average minus SME's annual average
  (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth
   WHERE CustomerID IN (
       SELECT y.CustomerID
       FROM yearmonth y
       JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
       WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
         AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
         AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       GROUP BY y.CustomerID
       ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
       LIMIT 1))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth
   WHERE CustomerID IN (
       SELECT y.CustomerID
       FROM yearmonth y
       JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
       WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
         AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
         AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       GROUP BY y.CustomerID
       ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
       LIMIT 1))
  AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
),
pct AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS percentage_increase
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM pct
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC;

WITH oldest_female AS (        -- Step 1: oldest female client(s)
    SELECT *
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                        FROM client
                        WHERE gender = 'F')
),
target AS (                    -- Step 2: among them, the one with lowest average salary (A11)
    SELECT o.client_id, d.A11
    FROM oldest_female o
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = o.district_id
    WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
                   FROM oldest_female o2
                   JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = o2.district_id)
)
SELECT a.account_id,                                       -- Step 3: account number(s)
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - t.A11 AS gap      -- Step 4: highest salary - lowest salary
FROM target t
JOIN disp dp   ON dp.client_id = t.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id;

SELECT

    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '97' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END),
    2

    SELECT d.account_id

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(b.spent)
     FROM budget AS b
     JOIN event AS e 
         ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
     WHERE SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019')
    -
    (SELECT SUM(b.spent)
     FROM budget AS b
     JOIN event AS e 
         ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
     WHERE SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020') AS difference;

WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero
);

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS in_patient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS outpatient_count,
    ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) /
          COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) * 100, 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outpatient_to_inpatient_ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = '30609';

SELECT
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    E.`Examination Date`,
    E.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E
    ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH > '500';

SELECT Patient.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND T2.`T-CHO` >= '250';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT SUM(
           CASE 
               WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' 
                    AND (T2.TP < '6.0' OR T2.TP > '8.5') 
               THEN 1 
               ELSE 0 
           END
       ) * 100.0 / COUNT(T2.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

SELECT AVG(E.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '+'
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) >= '50';

SELECT COUNT(ID) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', Description) = '1997' 
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T2.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(L.ID) / 12.0 AS avg_male_patients_per_month
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT 
    L.Date AS Lab_Work_Completed_Date,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age_At_Initial_Arrival
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND P.Birthday = (
        SELECT MIN(Birthday) 
        FROM Patient 
        WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS'
      )
ORDER BY L.Date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) AS num_underage_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 18;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_patients_with_elevated_bilirubin
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Average_Age
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

       E.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P
    ON E.ID = P.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.Date = E.`Examination Date`

SELECT ANA
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = 3605340

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS is_normal
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient

LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.`aCL IgM`

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P

SELECT T1.Diagnosis

SELECT e.Symptoms

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.Birthday = '1959-02-18' AND l.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) 
    -

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'

  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Description) < '1998';

SELECT DISTINCT ID

SELECT COUNT(ID)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M' 
  AND strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'

FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(T2.ALB)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T2.PLT > 400
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1997' 
  AND (T2.TP <= 6 OR T2.TP >= 8.5);

    SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_women

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P

WHERE P.SEX = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
FROM Patient AS P

WHERE P.ID = 57266

SELECT Date

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1

FROM Patient P

SELECT

    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TP < 6.0;

    L.ID, 
    L.TP,
    L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Laboratory AS L

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALB,
       CASE
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
           ELSE 'Not within normal range'
       END AS albumin_status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS female_percentage
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5);

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
     > SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Answer

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, L.`T-BIL`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` = (SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
           - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS REAL)
    / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P

WHERE L.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

  AND T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID

SELECT P.ID, L.GLU
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Description) = '1991'
  AND L.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.WBC <= 3.5
   OR l.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT
    P.ID,
    P.Diagnosis,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
  AND (L.RBC <= 3.5 OR L.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.HGB > 10
  AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC

SELECT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID
HAVING COUNT(l.ID) > 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 50

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY T2.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

  AND T2.IGA < 500

  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID

FROM Patient AS T1

       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
