SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.HCT <= 29 OR T2.HCT >= 52
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 'veins'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' 
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY T1.`First Date`
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND L.SSB IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA >= 8;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900 
  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000 
  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(L.ID)
     FROM Laboratory L
     JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
     WHERE L.GOT >= 60 AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE') * 1.0
    /
    (SELECT COUNT(ID)
     FROM Laboratory
     WHERE GOT >= 60) AS percentage;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS male_patients_normal_GOT
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.GOT < 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT < 60
ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GOT < 60;

SELECT T1.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.Date)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."First Date" = (SELECT MAX("First Date") FROM Patient)
  AND T1.LDH >= 500;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP >= 300
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' 
  AND T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SJS' 
  AND Laboratory.TP > 6.0 
  AND Laboratory.TP < 8.5;

SELECT E.`Examination Date`
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB > 3.5 AND L.ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY L.ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.ALB > 3.5
  AND l.ALB < 5.5
  AND l.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT E.`aCL IgG`, E.`aCL IgM`, E.`aCL IgA`
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' 
  AND L.UA > 6.50
ORDER BY L.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT ID
FROM Examination
WHERE ID IN (
        SELECT ID
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE CRE < 1.5
    )
ORDER BY `aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND Examination.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT E.ANA
FROM Examination AS E
WHERE E.ID = (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.`T-BIL` < 2.0
    ORDER BY L.`T-BIL` DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`T-CHO` >= 250 AND T2.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E
    ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG < 200
    ORDER BY TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 0 AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CPK < 250
  AND (T2.KCT = '+' OR T2.RVVT = '+' OR T2.LAC = '+');

SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday) AS Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU > 180;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.GLU < 180 AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.PLT > 100
  AND T2.PLT < 400
  AND T3.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T1.PLT
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.PLT > 100
  AND T1.PLT < 400
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'MCTD';

SELECT AVG(T2.PT) AS average_prothrombin_time
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE (T2.Thrombosis = 1 OR T2.Thrombosis = 2)
  AND T3.PT < 14;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_chlorine
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM bond
     JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
     WHERE molecule.label = '+'
       AND bond.bond_type = '-') * 1.0
    /
    (SELECT COUNT(atom_id)
     FROM atom
     JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
     WHERE molecule.label = '+') AS average_single_bonds;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' 
  AND atom.element = 'na';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
  AND label = '+';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
GROUP BY m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
GROUP BY element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(element_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS element_count
        FROM atom
        JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
        WHERE molecule.label = '-'
        GROUP BY element
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8');

SELECT DISTINCT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'sn'
);

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN a.atom_id END) AS iodine_atoms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_atoms
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND a.element IN ('i', 's');

SELECT c.atom_id,
       c.atom_id2,
       c.bond_id,
       b.molecule_id
FROM connected c
INNER JOIN bond b
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.molecule_id = 'TR181';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN m.molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id
                                       FROM atom
                                       WHERE element = 'f')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_not_containing_fluorine
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '#') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE label = '+';

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR001'
  AND c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+')
  -
  (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-') AS difference;

SELECT bond_id
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id2 = (
    SELECT atom_id2
    FROM connected
    WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2'
);

SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
FROM bond
WHERE bond_type = ' = '
ORDER BY molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT T1.element, T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR060';

SELECT b.bond_type,
       COUNT(b.bond_type) AS bond_count,
       m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
     ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT bond.molecule_id
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-'
ORDER BY bond.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT connected.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR009'
  AND (connected.atom_id = 'TR009_12' 
       OR connected.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'br';

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT a.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT COUNT(bond_id) AS num_connections
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19' 
   OR atom_id2 LIKE 'TR%_19';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25'
  AND T2.label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')
   OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id) / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS avg_bonds
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'i';

SELECT b.bond_type, c.bond_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE SUBSTR(c.atom_id, 7, 2) + 0 = 45;

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 
    ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 
    ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT b.molecule_id,
       COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT
       100.0 * MAX(COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)) OVER ()
             / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)) OVER () AS percentage
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id  = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1     ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2     ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element),
         MAX(a1.element, a2.element);

SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id),
    5
) AS proportion_carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 's';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE atom.element = 'sn';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.element) 
FROM bond AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT b.molecule_id
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
      )
  AND a.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT a2.molecule_id
        FROM atom a2
        WHERE a2.element = 'p' OR a2.element = 'br'
      );

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '+'
  AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) 
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'i';

SELECT MAX(molecule.label) 
FROM molecule 
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id 
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS has_both_elements
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a 
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id 
  OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-'
LIMIT 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2
  ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2
  ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT b.bond_id, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.element) AS ratio,
    T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY T2.label;

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'c';

SELECT a1.element AS element_1, 
       a2.element AS element_2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR151'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT atom_id, molecule_id, element
FROM atom
WHERE element = 'c'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) <= 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'h' 
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a 
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b 
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
  AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
       / COUNT(a.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h';

SELECT a1.element AS element_of_atom1,
       a2.element AS element_of_atom2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label AS carcinogenic_label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id, 
       b.molecule_id, 
       c.atom_id, 
       c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_chlorine_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
   OR a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS total_molecules_with_double_bond,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '='
    );

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'c' AND T1.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(atom.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_elements
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
  AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT bond.molecule_id
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE connected.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS num_carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'n'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T2.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T2.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR024'
  AND bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM bond b
WHERE b.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carbon_count
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008'
  AND element = 'c';

SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND (a1.element = 'o' OR a2.element = 'o');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR012'
  AND atom.element = 'c'
  AND bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND atom.element = 'o';

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS Eligible_Free_Rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY Eligible_Free_Rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
  AND f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1;

SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
  AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores 
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 400 
  AND schools.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT s.School
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores AS sa
JOIN schools AS s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sa.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sc.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (
    SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(
           frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
       ) AS highest_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores
    ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 / satscores.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / t.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    s.School,
    s.NCESSchool,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.District
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' 
  AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT 
    sc.School,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) 
FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T1.City = 'Fresno' 
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded' 
  AND T2.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador' 
  AND `Low Grade` = 9 
  AND `High Grade` = 12;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    schools.School,
    schools.Street,
    schools.City,
    schools.Zip,
    schools.State
FROM frpm
JOIN schools 
    ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30;

SELECT DISTINCT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT T3.School,
       T3.FundingType
FROM schools AS T3
INNER JOIN satscores AS T1
        ON T3.CDSCode = T1.cds
WHERE T3.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T3.School, T3.FundingType
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(*) > 400;

SELECT s.School,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT 
    T2.sname, 
    T2.AvgScrWrite, 
    T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.OpenDate) > '1991' 
   OR STRFTIME('%Y', T1.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCTYPE
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.City,
    SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS Total_Enrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY Total_Enrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_FRPM_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.DOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    f.`School Name`,
    s.Website
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' 
  AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T2.AdmFName1,
    T2.AdmLName1,
    T2.AdmFName2,
    T2.AdmLName2,
    T2.AdmFName3,
    T2.AdmLName3
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s 
    ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 / t.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND t.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sname
FROM (
    SELECT
        sc.sname,
        sh.County,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY sh.County
            ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC
        ) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sc
    JOIN schools sh
        ON sh.CDSCode = sc.cds
    WHERE sh.Virtual = 'F'
) ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT s.EILName
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    sc.School,
    st.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools sc
JOIN satscores st ON sc.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE (sc.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

SELECT T2.School, T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) / 12 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = '52'
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = 54 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = 52 THEN 1 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND County = 'Orange';

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
        SELECT County
        FROM schools
        WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
        GROUP BY County
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
      );

SELECT s.sname AS School_Name, sc.MailStreet AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT T2.MailStreet, T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) AS total_schools
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND (T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr) AS total_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.MailCity = 'Fresno';

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' 
  AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian';

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 END) AS ratio_colusa_to_humboldt
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND StatusType = 'Active'
  AND City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT s.Phone, s.Ext
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) 
FROM schools 
WHERE City = 'Hickman' 
  AND Charter = 1 
  AND DOC = 52;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM frpm AS F
JOIN schools AS S ON F.CDSCode = S.CDSCode
WHERE S.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND S.Charter = 0
  AND F.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / F.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT

WITH czk_2013 AS (                       -- CZK customers' consumption in 2013
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_per_segment AS (                     -- lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (                          -- avg = total consumption / count of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON m.Segment = z.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = z.Consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
     - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
       (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
     - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
       (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
     - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    -- Total consumption per segment for 2012 and 2013 (EUR customers only)
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    -- Apply the hint's formula: (2013 - 2012) / 2013 * 100
    SELECT
        Segment,
        cons_2012,
        cons_2013,
        (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS pct_change
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT
    Segment,
    cons_2012,
    cons_2013,
    ROUND(pct_change, 2) AS pct_change
FROM pct
WHERE pct_change = (SELECT MAX(pct_change) FROM pct)
   OR pct_change = (SELECT MIN(pct_change) FROM pct);

SELECT
    (( CAST(late.balance AS REAL) - early.balance ) * 100.0 / early.balance ) AS increase_rate
FROM
    -- Balance on date B: 1993-03-22
    (SELECT balance
     FROM trans
     WHERE account_id = (
             SELECT account_id
             FROM loan
             WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
               AND status IN ('A', 'C')        -- approved loans
             ORDER BY loan_id                  -- the FIRST approved loan that day
             LIMIT 1)
       AND date = '1993-03-22'
     ORDER BY trans_id DESC                    -- last transaction of that day
     LIMIT 1) AS early,

    -- Balance on date A: 1998-12-27
    (SELECT balance
     FROM trans
     WHERE account_id = (
             SELECT account_id
             FROM loan
             WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
               AND status IN ('A', 'C')
             ORDER BY loan_id
             LIMIT 1)
       AND date = '1998-12-27'
     ORDER BY trans_id DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS late;

SELECT d.district_id,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY num_accounts DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.client_id,
       c.gender,
       c.birth_date,
       d.type AS disp_role
FROM "order" o
JOIN disp   d ON o.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE o.order_id = 32423;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'junior'
  AND cd.issued >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
         -
         SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
        * 100.0
        /
        SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END),
    2) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d    ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c  ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) IN (1996, 1997);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS credit_card_withdrawals
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND date > '951231';

SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia')
    -
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia')
    AS crime_difference_1996;

SELECT 
    type,
    COUNT(*) AS disposition_count
FROM disp
WHERE account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
GROUP BY type;

SELECT a.frequency,          -- how often statements are released
       t.k_symbol            -- purpose of the debit(s)
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3
  AND t.type = 'VYDEJ'       -- debit (withdrawal) transactions
  AND t.amount = 3539;

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.account_id = 130
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount     AS loan_amount,
    l.payments   AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration   AS duration_months,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Contract running - OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Contract running - client IN DEBT'
    END          AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp   d ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan   l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992
  AND l.status IN ('B', 'D')

SELECT t.balance, c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 4
  AND t.trans_id = 851;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998';

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS account_district
FROM client c
JOIN disp    ON disp.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id  = disp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1987-12-31'

FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN trans ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND client.birth_date BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'

FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id

        / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 
        2
    ) AS female_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district t ON a.district_id = t.district_id

FROM client c
JOIN disp d 
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a 
    ON d.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients

JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT l.account_id,
       l.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 24
  AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
        FROM loan l2
        JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
        WHERE l2.duration > 24
          AND a2.date < '1997-01-01'
      );

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp    d  ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
JOIN account a  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC,   -- earliest birth date = oldest
         di.A11 ASC          -- lowest average salary in her district
