JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'A-Bomb';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT gender.gender
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Agent 13';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Adaptation';

SELECT COUNT(hp.power_id) AS num_powers
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Amazo';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Hunter Zolomon';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour ec ON s.eye_colour_id = ec.id
JOIN colour hc ON s.hair_colour_id = hc.id
WHERE ec.colour = 'Black'
  AND hc.colour = 'Black';

SELECT C2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero S
JOIN colour C1 ON S.skin_colour_id = C1.id
JOIN colour C2 ON S.eye_colour_id = C2.id
WHERE C1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS num_heroes
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  );

SELECT race.race, alignment.alignment
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Cameron Hicks';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky')
    -
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;

SELECT 
    superhero_name,
    SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
WHERE race_id = 21 
  AND gender_id = 1;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT attribute.attribute_name, hero_attribute.attribute_value
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = '3-D Man';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour eye_colour ON s.eye_colour_id = eye_colour.id
JOIN colour hair_colour ON s.hair_colour_id = hair_colour.id
WHERE eye_colour.colour = 'Blue'
  AND hair_colour.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy');

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Helen Parr';

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg = 108
  AND superhero.height_cm = 188;

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE hero_attribute.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute
);

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c
    ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.alignment_id = 3;

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS good_female_count
FROM superhero
WHERE alignment_id = 1
  AND gender_id = 2;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       * 100.0 / COUNT(superhero.id) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN gender    ON gender.id    = superhero.gender_id
JOIN alignment ON alignment.id = superhero.alignment_id
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
     - SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg = 0 
   OR s.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_superhero_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name ASC;

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg = (
      SELECT MAX(s2.weight_kg)
      FROM superhero s2
      JOIN publisher p2 ON s2.publisher_id = p2.id
      WHERE p2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  );

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT
    SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics')      AS dc_count,
    SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')  AS marvel_count,
    SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM superhero s2
      JOIN hero_attribute ha2 ON ha2.hero_id = s2.id
      WHERE s2.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
  );

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN alignment.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute
ORDER BY attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'More in-patients'
        ELSE 'More outpatients'
    END AS comparison,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS inpatient_to_outpatient_ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = '30609';

SELECT 
    P.SEX, 
    P.Birthday, 
    E.`Examination Date`, 
    E.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH > 500;

SELECT T1.ID,
       CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND L."T-CHO" >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS REAL) * 100
       / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Patient) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND (T2.TP < '6.0' OR T2.TP > '8.5');

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Admission` = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`Birthday`) AS INTEGER)) >= 50;

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT strftime('%Y', `First Date`) - strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS `Age`
FROM Patient
ORDER BY Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997' 
  AND T2.Thrombosis = '1' 
  AND T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = (
        SELECT MAX(p2.Birthday)
        FROM Patient p2
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM Examination e2 
            WHERE e2.ID = p2.ID
        )
      )
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) / 12 AS avg_male_patients_per_month
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT 
    L.Date,
    CAST(SUBSTR(P.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN Patient AS P 
    ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_patients
FROM (
    SELECT T1.ID
    FROM Patient AS T1
    JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
    GROUP BY T1.ID
    HAVING MIN(
        CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER)
        -
        CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
    ) >= 1
) AS eligible_patients;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 18
  AND SUBSTR(`Examination Date`, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age,
       T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T3.ID = T1.ID
WHERE T3.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT ANA
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = 3605340
  AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN `T-CHO` < 250 THEN 'Yes, normal level'
         ELSE 'No, abnormal level'
       END AS total_cholesterol_status
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464
  AND Date = '1995-09-04';

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY `First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT DISTINCT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT COUNT(lab.ID) AS total_lab_tests
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS lab ON p.ID = lab.ID
WHERE p.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND lab.Date LIKE '1995%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959/3/1'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993/9/27';

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(l.`T-CHO`)
   FROM Laboratory l
   JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
   WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
     AND l.Date LIKE '1981-11-%')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(l.`T-CHO`)
   FROM Laboratory l
   JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
   WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
     AND l.Date LIKE '1981-12-%') AS decrease_rate;

SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND Description >= '1997-01-01'
  AND Description < '1998-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND L.GPT > 30
  AND L.ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS patient_count,
       ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
       / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
WHERE `U-PRO` > 0 AND `U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT SUM(DIAGNOSIS = 'BEHCET') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';

SELECT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND l.CRP > 2
  AND l.CRE = 1
  AND l.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(T2.ALB)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T2.PLT > 400
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT MAX(T1.Symptoms) AS Most_Common_Sign
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_APS_patients
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND Diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory
WHERE strftime('%Y', DATE) = '1997'
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
    / SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND Examination.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND T2.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT JULIANDAY(e.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA > 8.0) 
           OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA > 6.5) 
         THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS uric_acid_within_normal_range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = 57266;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = '48473'
  AND GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GOT < 60
  AND strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1994';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.GPT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT > 60
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT 
       Patient.ID, 
       (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALP < 300;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALP,
       CASE 
           WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT
    Patient.ID,
    Patient.SEX,
    Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory
    ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TP < 6.0;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    P.ID, 
    P.SEX, 
    P.Birthday, 
    P.Description, 
    P.[First Date], 
    P.Admission, 
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID,
       CASE
           WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
           ELSE 'Not within normal range'
       END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN L.UA > 6.5 THEN P.ID END)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID),
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.UA IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P 
    ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID          -- latest lab exam per patient
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)   -- normal range for male
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)   -- normal range for female
      );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory);

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT L.ID,
       L."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
ORDER BY L."T-CHO" DESC,   -- highest total cholesterol first
         P.Birthday ASC    -- among ties, the oldest (earliest) birthday first
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) / COUNT(P.ID) AS Average_Age
FROM 
    Patient AS P
WHERE 
    P.SEX = 'M'
    AND P.ID IN (
        SELECT ID 
        FROM Laboratory 
        WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250
    );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'
  AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    P.ID, 
    P.SEX, 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180
  AND L."T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Description) AS INTEGER) = 1991
  AND T2.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5 OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY P.SEX ASC, P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       p.Diagnosis,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Laboratory.HGB < 10;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.HGB > 10
  AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.ID,
       strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID, T2.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(T1.ID) > 2;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_higher_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
      - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 50
  AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pct_female_abnormal_PT
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    P.`First Date`,
    P.Admission,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) > 1992
  AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' 
  AND T2.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.APTT > 45
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.WBC > 3.5
  AND L.WBC < 9.0
  AND (L.FG <= 150 OR L.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` >= 30
);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY L.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGA > 80
  AND Laboratory.IGA < 500
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(Patient.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGM <= 40 OR L.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY P.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(P.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRP = '+'
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 1985
  AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND E.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.C3 > 35
  AND T3.[ANA Pattern] = 'P';

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory  AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE NOT (T3.HCT > 29 AND T3.HCT < 52)
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RNP IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l
     ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
WHERE Patient.ID IN (
        SELECT Laboratory.ID
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE Laboratory.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
      )
  AND Patient.`First Date` = (
        SELECT MIN(Patient.`First Date`)
        FROM Patient
        WHERE Patient.ID IN (
                SELECT Laboratory.ID
                FROM Laboratory
                WHERE Laboratory.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
              )
      );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.DNA >= 8;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900
  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000
  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.GOT < 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) AS Youngest_Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT < 60
GROUP BY T1.ID, T1.Birthday
ORDER BY MAX(T2.GPT) DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS male_patients
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT < 60
  AND P.SEX = 'M';

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS first_recorded_date
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(L.Date) AS latest_medical_data_date
FROM Laboratory AS L
WHERE L.ID = (
    SELECT P.ID
    FROM Patient AS P
    JOIN Laboratory AS Lab ON P.ID = Lab.ID
    WHERE Lab.LDH >= 500
    ORDER BY P.`First Date` DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_admitted_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALP >= 300
  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.ALP < 300;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' 
  AND T2.TP > 6.0 
  AND T2.TP < 8.5;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT E.`aCL IgG`, E.`aCL IgM`, E.`aCL IgA`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.UA <= 6.50
ORDER BY L.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS Highest_ANA
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.ANA
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` < 2.0
ORDER BY T2.`T-BIL` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` >= 250
  AND e.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG < 200
    ORDER BY TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L  ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 0
  AND L.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CPK < 250
  AND (T2.KCT = '+' 
       OR T2.RVVT = '+' 
       OR T2.LAC = '+');

SELECT MIN(P.Birthday) AS Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU > 180;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.GLU < 180
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '+'
  AND Laboratory.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.PLT > 100 
  AND T2.PLT < 400 
  AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

SELECT L.PLT
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND L.PLT > 100
  AND L.PLT < 400;

SELECT AVG(L.PT) AS average_prothrombin_time
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis IN (1, 2)
  AND l.PT < 14

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecule_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT AVG(a.element = 'o') AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '-') / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom      ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'na'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
       / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
  AND label = '+';

SELECT a1.element AS element_atom1,
       a2.element AS element_atom2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'h'
GROUP BY T2.label
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.label) DESC

JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'o';

FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation School'

LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.MailStreet

SELECT T1.Phone

SELECT School, SOCType, Latitude

SELECT COUNT(schools.School) AS num_schools,
       schools.City

WITH admins AS (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName1 <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName2 <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName3 <> ''
)
SELECT first_name AS most_common_first_name,
       District,
       COUNT(*)      AS name_count
FROM admins
GROUP BY first_name, District
ORDER BY name_count DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT 
    f.`District Code`,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' 
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'

SELECT p.Title

        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_SME_LAM,

    /* LAM annual average - KAM annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_LAM_KAM,

    /* KAM annual average - SME annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'SME'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_KAM_SME;

    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Total_2013,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END))
        * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END),
        2
    ) AS Pct_Increase
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT c.name AS country
FROM Country c
JOIN match_players mp ON mp.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p         ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(p.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_weight)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS avg_weight
        FROM Country c2
        JOIN match_players mp2 ON mp2.country_id = c2.id
        JOIN Player p2         ON p2.player_api_id = mp2.player_api_id
        GROUP BY c2.name
    ) t
);

JOIN superhero sh ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
WHERE sh.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS in_patient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS outpatient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) * 1.0 /
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS FLOAT) /
    NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END), 0) AS ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT p.Diagnosis,
       l.Date AS Lab_Test_Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = '30609';

SELECT 
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    E.`Examination Date`,
    E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E 
    ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH > 500;

SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND T2.`T-CHO` >= '250';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.TP < 6.0 OR L.TP > 8.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(L.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50;

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', `First Date`) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
ORDER BY Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS num_women
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND E.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = (
    SELECT MAX(p2.Birthday)
    FROM Patient AS p2
    JOIN Examination AS e2 ON p2.ID = e2.ID
)
AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT
    L.Date,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) -
        CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age_At_First_Visit
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_abnormal_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_abnormal_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', Examination.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS underage_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Examination.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS AverageAge
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age,
    p.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient     AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT ANA
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = 3605340
  AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN `T-CHO` < 250 THEN 'Yes, at normal level'
         ELSE 'No, not at normal level'
       END AS CholesterolStatus
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464
  AND Date = '1995-09-04';

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY "First Date" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' 
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4'
  AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(L.ID) AS total_lab_tests
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND L.Date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1959/3/1'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993/9/27';

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(l.`T-CHO`)
   FROM Laboratory l
   JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
   WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
     AND l.Date LIKE '1981-11-%')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(l.`T-CHO`)
   FROM Laboratory l
   JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
   WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
     AND l.Date LIKE '1981-12-%') AS decrease_rate;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND strftime('%Y', Patient.Description) >= '1997'
  AND strftime('%Y', Patient.Description) < '1998';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS PatientCount
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND GPT > 30
  AND ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E
        ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination)
                  + (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 0.2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M' 
  AND strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L."T-BIL" < 2.0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE E.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(T1.ALB)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SEX = 'F'
  AND T1.PLT > 400
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' 
  AND Diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory
WHERE strftime('%Y', DATE) = '1997'
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Laboratory.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(julianday(e.`Examination Date`) - julianday(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS uric_acid_normal
FROM   Laboratory L
JOIN   Patient P 
       ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE  L.ID = 57266
  AND  ( (L.UA > 8.0 AND P.SEX = 'M') 
      OR (L.UA > 6.5 AND P.SEX = 'F') );

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = '48473'
  AND GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT < 60
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1994';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.GPT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT > 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID, 
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALP < 300;

SELECT 
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.0;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.TP,
    (l.TP - 8.5) AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    Patient.ID,
    Patient.SEX,
    Patient.Birthday,
    Patient.Description,
    Patient."First Date",
    Patient.Admission,
    Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS Albumin_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN L.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T3.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS T3
        WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
      )
  AND (
        (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
        OR
        (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    l.[T-BIL] AS Highest_T_BIL,
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.[T-BIL] = (SELECT MAX([T-BIL]) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT 
    Patient.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT  P.ID,
        L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO")
                   FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC   -- oldest = earliest birthday
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) 
FROM Patient AS P 
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE L.TG >= 200 
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1936 AND 1956
  AND Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CPK >= 250;

SELECT 
    P.ID, 
    P.SEX, 
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 
  AND L."T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT DISTINCT L.ID, L.GLU
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.GLU < 180
  AND strftime('%Y', P.Description) = '1991';

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5
   OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY P.SEX,
         P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.ID,
    T1.Diagnosis,
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.HGB < 10;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.HGB > 10
  AND l.HGB < 17
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(l.ID) > 2;

SELECT AVG(HCT) AS average_hct
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date LIKE '1991%'
  AND HCT < 29;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_higher_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 50
  AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pct_female_abnormal_PT
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) > 1992
  AND Laboratory.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS normal_aptt_count
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.APTT > 45
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5
  AND T2.WBC < 9.0
  AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900 
  AND l.IGG < 2000 
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
  AND L.IGA = (
      SELECT MAX(IGA)
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990
  AND L.IGA > 80
  AND L.IGA < 500;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE IGM <= 40 OR IGM >= 400
)
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 1985
  AND L.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.RF < 20 AND T2.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.C3 > 35
  AND Examination.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.HCT <= 29 OR T1.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T2.`aCL IgA`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-')

    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS hydrogen_ratio,
    m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT m.label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM bond

    SELECT atom.molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE atom.element = 'c'
);

SELECT DISTINCT
       a1.element AS element_1,
       a2.element AS element_2
FROM   connected c
JOIN   atom a1
       ON a1.atom_id = SUBSTR(c.bond_id, 1, 5) || '_' || SUBSTR(c.bond_id, 7, 2)
JOIN   atom a2
       ON a2.atom_id = SUBSTR(c.bond_id, 1, 5) || '_' || SUBSTR(c.bond_id, 10, 2)
WHERE  c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN molecule_id END) * 100.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS triple_bond_percent
FROM bond;

SELECT m.molecule_id,

           ELSE 'Not carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT a.atom_id

  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT COUNT(*)

JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_hydrogen_atoms
FROM atom

WHERE atom.element = 'h'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id

  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'h'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
    / COUNT(molecule.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id;

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

SELECT a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.element AS atom2_element

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
    AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id, atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       c.atom_id,
       c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id, a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
ORDER BY b.molecule_id, a.element;

SELECT a1.element, a2.element

JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'

SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types

JOIN bond b     ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS molecules_with_double_bond,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_double_bond_molecules

SELECT COUNT(*)

FROM bond b

SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(atom_id) AS atom_count
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id) AS percentage

WITH total_cons AS ( SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment ), min_cons AS ( SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption FROM total_cons GROUP BY Segment ), avg_cons AS ( SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg FROM total_cons t JOIN min_cons m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption GROUP BY t.Segment ) SELECT (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM, (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM, (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS ( SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') GROUP BY c.Segment ) SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM pct) OR Percentage = (SELECT MIN(Percentage) FROM pct) ORDER BY Percentage DESC

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS minTotal
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avgCons
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.minTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avgCons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avgCons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avgCons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avgCons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avgCons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avgCons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013,
         SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
mx AS (
  SELECT segment, (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct
  FROM t
  ORDER BY pct DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
mn AS (
  SELECT segment, (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct
  FROM t
  ORDER BY pct ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT segment, pct FROM mx
UNION ALL
SELECT segment, pct FROM mn;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avgs AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt
      ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
           / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Percentage
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage
FROM pct
WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM pct)
   OR Percentage = (SELECT MIN(Percentage) FROM pct)

    FROM t
    JOIN m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.Consumption = m.minc
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avgc FROM a WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avgc FROM a WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS d1,
    (SELECT avgc FROM a WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avgc FROM a WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS d2,

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS PctIncrease
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, PctIncrease FROM pct WHERE PctIncrease = (SELECT MAX(PctIncrease) FROM pct)

SELECT (ld.overall_rating - jb.overall_rating) * 100.0 / ld.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM
  (SELECT pa.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes pa
   JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date = '2013-07-12') ld,
  (SELECT pa.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes pa
   JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND pa.date = '2013-07-12') jb;

   OR m.home_player_6 = p.player_api_id

    SELECT *
    FROM Match
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
),
italy_players AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS player_id FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia'

FROM account AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague' AND T3.type = 'OWNER';
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000

SELECT d.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - di.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND di.A11 = (
      SELECT MIN(di2.A11)
      FROM client c2
      JOIN district di2 ON c2.district_id = di2.district_id
      WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
        AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  )

SELECT d.account_id
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district t ON c.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND t.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT (T2.balance - T1.balance) * 100 / T1.balance
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND T2.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND T1.account_id = (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM loan
      WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'C'
      ORDER BY loan_id
      LIMIT 1
