WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT y.Segment, SUM(y.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN min_per_segment m 
        ON y.Segment = m.Segment AND y.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY y.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
           ) * 100.0
           / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)

SELECT event.event_name, event.location
FROM event
JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event
WHERE budget.remaining > 0;

SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name, e.event_date
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense ex ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE ex.expense_description = 'Pizza' AND ex.cost > 50 AND ex.cost < 100;

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, ma.major_name
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > 100;

SELECT z.city, z.county
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
JOIN income i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
GROUP BY z.city, z.county
HAVING COUNT(i.income_id) > 40;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_amount
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) > 1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id)
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING SUM(ex.cost) < (
    SELECT SUM(ex2.cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT b2.link_to_event)
    FROM budget b2
    JOIN expense ex2 ON b2.budget_id = ex2.link_to_budget
    WHERE b2.category = 'Parking'
);

WITH czk_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_totals t
    JOIN min_totals m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM annual_avg;

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_segment,
       (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_segment;

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg, y.CustomerID AS cid, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT seg, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY seg
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    SELECT p.seg, p.total_consumption AS min_total, COUNT(*) AS num_lowest
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN min_per_segment m ON m.seg = p.seg AND m.min_total = p.total_consumption
    GROUP BY p.seg, p.total_consumption
),
annual_average AS (
    SELECT seg, min_total * 1.0 / num_lowest AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_per_segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN seg = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) - SUM(CASE WHEN seg = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN seg = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) - SUM(CASE WHEN seg = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN seg = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) - SUM(CASE WHEN seg = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM annual_average;

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS percentage_increase
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM (
  SELECT Segment, percentage_increase FROM pct ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM (
  SELECT Segment, percentage_increase FROM pct ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC LIMIT 1
);

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_2 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_3 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_4 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_5 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_6 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_7 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_8 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_9 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_10 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_11 = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p ON p.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira')
   AND p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11);

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player AS T3 ON T1.home_player_2 = T3.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player AS T4 ON T1.home_player_3 = T4.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player AS T5 ON T1.home_player_4 = T5.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player AS T6 ON T1.home_player_5 = T6.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player AS T7 ON T1.home_player_6 = T7.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player AS T8 ON T1.home_player_7 = T8.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player AS T9 ON T1.home_player_8 = T9.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player AS T10 ON T1.home_player_9 = T10.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player AS T11 ON T1.home_player_10 = T11.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player AS T12 ON T1.home_player_11 = T12.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < 31
  AND strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T3.birthday) < 31
  AND strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T4.birthday) < 31
  AND strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T5.birthday) < 31
  AND strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T6.birthday) < 31
  AND strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T7.birthday) < 31
  AND strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T8.birthday) < 31
  AND strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T9.birthday) < 31
  AND strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T10.birthday) < 31
  AND strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T11.birthday) < 31
  AND strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', T12.birthday) < 31;
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T2.player_name
FROM Player AS T2
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T1 ON T2.player_api_id = T1.player_api_id
WHERE T1.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.finishing = 1 ORDER BY julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime')) - julianday(datetime(T1.birthday)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT C.name
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Country AS C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM (
  SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) mp
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = mp.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(P.height)
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
                         M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country AS C
  ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23);

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(player_api_id)
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing)
                  FROM Player_Attributes
                  WHERE preferred_foot = 'left')
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT Player_Attributes.sprint_speed, Player_Attributes.agility, Player_Attributes.acceleration
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';
SELECT T_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS T_Attributes ON T.team_api_id = T_Attributes.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match 
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id 
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id 
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' 
  AND Country.name = 'Italy';
SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) FROM Match M JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';
SELECT T1.finishing, T1.curve FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
ORDER BY M.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.height < 180 AND T2.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN loan ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT '1995' AS year, AVG(A12) AS average_unemployment FROM district
UNION ALL
SELECT '1996' AS year, AVG(A13) AS average_unemployment FROM district
ORDER BY average_unemployment DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

SELECT account.account_id
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE client.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND district.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id)
FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND disp.type = 'Owner';

SELECT DISTINCT client.client_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND disp.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.status = 'A'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1997'
  AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY T2.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) = 1993
  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
        FROM loan AS l2
        JOIN account AS a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
        WHERE l2.duration > 12
          AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a2.date) AS INTEGER) = 1993
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id)
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND district.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT account_id, date
FROM account
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1995
  AND date = (
      SELECT MIN(date)
      FROM account
      WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1995
  );
SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id FROM account AS T1 JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.date < '1997-01-01' AND T2.balance > 3000
SELECT T1.client_id FROM disp AS T1 JOIN card AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id WHERE T2.issued = '1994-03-03'

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25' AND loan.status = 'A';
SELECT MAX(T1.amount) FROM trans AS T1 JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id WHERE T3.issued = '1996-10-21'

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
  AND t.date > a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC, t.trans_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id)
FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = account.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND client.gender = 'F'

SELECT disp.disp_id
FROM disp
JOIN trans ON disp.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 5100
  AND trans.date = '1998-09-02';
SELECT COUNT(account.account_id) FROM account INNER JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996'

SELECT district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = account.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832
  AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY account.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.client_id) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT ((SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND date = '1998-12-27' ORDER BY trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND date = '1993-03-22' ORDER BY trans_id DESC LIMIT 1)) * 100.0 / (SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND date = '1993-03-22' ORDER BY trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS increase_rate FROM loan l WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' AND l.status = 'A' ORDER BY l.loan_id LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan

SELECT account.account_id, district.A2, district.A3
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', account.date) AS INTEGER) = 1993
AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT account.account_id, account.frequency
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', account.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2, d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT loan.account_id, district.A2, district.A3
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.amount > 300000;

SELECT loan.loan_id, district.A3 AS district, district.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.duration = 60;

SELECT d.A2 AS district, ((d.A13 - d.A12) * 1.0 / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A12, d.A13;
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN district.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1993'
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(*) AS num_female_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_holders DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN card ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND card.card_id IS NULL;

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY MAX(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(l.amount) FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'M';
SELECT district_id, A2, A13 FROM district WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district) ORDER BY A13 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trans.account_id)
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND trans.balance < 0
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND account.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card INNER JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
SELECT COUNT(account.account_id) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold';

SELECT strftime('%m', date) AS month, AVG(amount) AS average_amount
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
GROUP BY strftime('%m', date);

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
      SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
      FROM trans t2
      WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1998'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND LOWER(d.A3) LIKE '%south bohemia%'

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = account.account_id

SELECT T.first_name, T.last_name, T.total
FROM (
    SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) AS event_cnt
    FROM expense e
    JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id

) AS T

WITH seg_min AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg,
           MIN(t.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS t
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND t.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg,
           SUM(t.Consumption) / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM yearmonth AS t
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    INNER JOIN seg_min AS m
        ON m.seg = c.Segment
       AND t.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND t.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE seg = 'SME') AS KAM_SME;

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
                      - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END))
              / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 2) AS pct
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
  ORDER BY pct DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (

);

JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT CAST(SUM(chanceCreationPassing) AS REAL) / COUNT(id)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'

ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_increase
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM pct)

WITH czk_annual AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_avg AS (
    SELECT ca.Segment,
           SUM(ca.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_annual AS ca
    INNER JOIN min_per_segment AS m
        ON ca.Segment = m.Segment
       AND ca.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ca.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH minc AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(y.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avgc AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN minc m ON m.Segment = c.Segment AND y.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
           / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PctIncrease
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY PctIncrease DESC LIMIT 1) AS BiggestIncrease,
       (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY PctIncrease ASC LIMIT 1) AS LowestIncrease;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
            SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
            SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.APTT < 45
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5 
  AND T2.WBC < 9.0 
  AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0 AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500 ORDER BY IGA DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990 AND T2.IGA > 80 AND T2.IGA < 500;

SELECT T2.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.IGM <= 40 OR T1.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY T2.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.KCT = '+';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 1985 AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA IN ('-', '+-'));
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.RF < 20 AND T2.Thrombosis = '0'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.`C3` > 35 AND T3.`ANA Pattern` = 'P'

SELECT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T3.HCT NOT BETWEEN 29 AND 52 
GROUP BY T1.ID 
ORDER BY MAX(T2.`aCL IgA`) DESC 
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.Admission = '+';
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' 
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND P.ID NOT IN (
      SELECT E.ID
      FROM Examination E
      WHERE E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;
